source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of computational thinking (PDF 25).

blocks.text: Yeh chapter computer science mein use hone wale mantiq (logic) aur computational thinking ke bunyadi khayalat se ta'aruf karata hai: masail ko wazeh aur munazzam tareeqe se kaise hal karein. Is mein decomposition aur qadam ba qadam masla hal karne jaisi computational thinking ki techniques; propositional logic, truth values, truth tables aur mantiqi barabari (equivalence); satisfiable aur unsatisfiable propositions; predicate logic, variables aur quantifiers; aur aakhir mein mantiqi istidlal (reasoning) aur nateeja nikalna (inference) shamil hain.

blocks.title: Computational thinking
blocks.text: Computational thinking sochne ka aisa tareeqa hai jo masail ko wazeh aur mantiqi tareeqe se hal karta hai: masla samjha jata, chhote hisson mein toota jata aur qadam ba qadam hal kiya jata hai.

Computational thinking ka matlab hai masla hal karne wale ki tarah sochna. Yeh sirf computer science ke talaba ke liye nahi. Hum masla qadam ba qadam samajhte, bare masle ko chhote hisson mein torte, masail aur hal mein naqsh (patterns) dhoondte, ghair zaroori tafseelat hata kar ahem nukat par tawajjuh dete, aur phir masla hal karne ke wazeh qadam banate hain. Yeh qadam log ya computers dono follow kar sakte hain, aur yeh mantiqi aur wazeh sochne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Scientists, engineers aur bawarchi bhi pecheeda kaam ki mansooba bandi mein computational thinking use karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Masla hal karne mein computational thinking kyun ahem hai? Rozmarra ki aik misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh bare, uljhe masle ko wazeh qadmon wale chhote hisson mein badal deta hai, is liye hal dhoondna, jaanchna aur dohrana, insaan ya computer ke liye, asan hota hai. Misal: school trip ko transport, khana, ijazat-name aur nizam-ul-auqat mein baantna, har saal dohrai jane wali cheezein dekhna, ghair ahem tafseel chhorna, aur tarteeb-war checklist likhna.

items: Computational thinking: masla samajhna, torna aur qadam ba qadam hal karna.
Aadatein: decomposition, naqsh, abstraction (tafseel hatana), algorithm (wazeh qadam).
Log aur computers dono ke liye; sirf computer scientists ke liye nahi.
